name: ValidationSummary
description: Lists every error in a form after a failed submit, each linked to its field. Livewire reads Laravel's error bag; React and Vue take an errors prop. It is not ErrorState.

props.name: errors
props.description: The errors: [{ field, message }], or a map of field to message(s). field is the control's id or name. Livewire defaults to the first message of every key in $errors. Renders nothing when empty.

props.name: only
props.description: The fields ($errors keys) to list, in order. Defaults to every one.

props.name: color
props.description: Error blocks the submit and is an alert; warning lists non-blocking recommendations and is a status. Emitted as data-color.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading. Defaults to Fix 1 field / Fix N fields (error) or 1 recommendation / N recommendations (warning); Livewire translates the defaults.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { title: '…', list: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The panel: icon, title and list. Focusable (tabindex=-1), and focused when it appears.

parts.name: icon
parts.description: circle-alert for errors, triangle-alert for warnings (aria-hidden).

parts.name: link
parts.description: The message, linking to #field; activating it moves focus to the field.

requirements: Rendered at the top of the form after a failed submit, focused (tabindex=-1) and role=alert; warnings use role=status and aren't focused.
Each link moves focus to its field: the element with that id, else the control with that name or wire:model.
Fields keep their own inline errors, with the same wording.
Don't show it before the first submit.
The color is never the only signal: the title says how many fields to fix.
